Yang Mun 

#yangmun #usahealth #usa #american #newyork
transcript: My friend, rather than wasting your life stressing over the perfect decision, learn to make the decision perfect by the way you walk it. Even my teacher once said, when the mind hesitates too long, the spirit grows weak. If I ask you to choose between two sweets, an almond, joy or a Snickers, you simply pick one. No fear, no overthinking, because in truth, nobody will care which one you choose. Life works the same way. Marriage or no marriage, take the job or leave it. You cannot live all versions of yourself. You only walk one path in this lifetime. If there were a magical doorway that let you live two lives, one with three children and another with none, then you could compare, but such a doorway does not exist. So my students ask me, Master Harvard or Yale, and I tell them, whichever you choose, enter with your whole heart. If they choose Harvard and find hardship, they say, ah, I should have gone to Yale. But they do not know that Yale might have been worse or better or exactly the same. This is why regret is so foolish. Regret imagines that the road not taken was filled with peace and blessings, but that is only a fantasy of the mind. Choose your path, walk it with courage, and the path will become right because you made it so.
